description: This file defines the ExecutorRunner class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a Spark executor process in standalone mode, including starting, monitoring, and terminating the process, as well as handling resource setup and logging.

classes.name: ExecutorRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution lifecycle of a Spark executor process, including starting, stopping, resource management, and logging.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the executor process in a new thread, setting up shutdown hooks.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Terminates the executor process and notifies the worker of the process exit status.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Stops the executor runner and interrupts the worker thread.

methods.name: substituteVariables
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in command arguments with actual runtime values.

methods.name: fetchAndRunExecutor
methods.description: Downloads resources, constructs the command, launches the executor process, and manages its output and lifecycle.
